summary: Will a Rs 8,000 monthly SIP at 12% reach Rs 25 lakh in 12 years?
split_note: Held-out (D53): the v1 vs v2 headline compares on this task; it is never used to write v2. Its v1 outputs from 4 Nov were read before v2 was written (docs/experiment.md).

messages.content: I want ₹25 lakh for my daughter's education in 12 years. If I invest ₹8,000 a month in a SIP and it earns 12% a year, will I get there?

graders.description: The judge (rubric advice.v1, D68): yes/no criteria, each answered on its own with a quote; optional until each passes the trust bar on held-out labels (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the advisor explain each key figure in plain words, so this client would understand what it means for them? Yes or no.

judge_criteria_to_write: Judgment: the plan does reach Rs 25 lakh at 12%; does the answer say so plainly, and say that 12% is not guaranteed?
